libs.note: BH-9414 slice C0: the always-run guard suites of a project. HARNESS_SUITE_RUN (bin/lib/rb/gates.sh) adds them to a selected pre-push suite run, and a guard list it cannot read makes the run full. tests/verify-guards.bh-9414-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: Comma list of guard sources, read at the head commit. `<file>` is a text file with one path or glob per line; `<file>#<key>` is a JSON file whose <key> is an array of path strings (project-6: scripts/ci/lane-rules.json alwaysSuites, TK-3641). Every file under tests/static-guards/ is always added. Read by bin/lib/verify-guards.sh (vg_list).

knobs.zero_means: any guard path makes the run full
knobs.note: The most guard paths a selected run takes. A list over it is a misread source, so the run goes full (the safe side). Read by bin/lib/verify-guards.sh (vg_list).
